Welcome to the world's worst delivery hub. A wall of parcels is barreling down the belt, you've got two hands and four chutes, and the floor manager is already disappointed. Letters, boxes, crates, gifts — flick each one the right way, keep your combo screaming, and whatever you do, don't drop the one that's meowing. This is fast, funny, fully physical VR sorting where a single bad throw turns a smooth shift into glorious chaos. Clock in. Sort fast. Try not to get fired.

Two Modes

🔁 Arcade — endless and relentless. The belt never stops and the pace never quits — it just keeps speeding up. Chain clean sorts to crank your combo multiplier and survive as long as your nerves hold. Every 90 seconds a boss wave floods your station — giant parcels, swarms of tiny ones, pure mayhem — and on your very last life, time drops into slow-mo for one final Last Chance to save the run.

⏱️ Deadline — work the shift, then push your luck. Every truck pays better — and arrives meaner — than the last. Clean sorts bank cash, mistakes bleed it, and three slip-ups on a single truck gets you fired on the spot. Survive every truck on your shift and you can clock out with a fat completion bonus… or gamble it on an overtime shift: the bonus is gone, your margin for error is razor-thin, and there's no clocking out — you ride until you drop. Banked pay is always safe; it's this load that's on the line. Pick Easy, Normal, or Hard and chase the biggest paycheck of your career.

Features

📦 Four parcel types — Letters, Packages, Crates and Gifts, each to its own chute. Mind the Fragile labels (don't drop them) and the This-Side-Up ones (don't flip them).

🌙 Shift modifiers — clock into a Night Shift (lights out, headlamp on), survive Peak Season (double speed), suffer Arm Day (heavy freight — two hands or it's not moving), or squint through Damaged Labels.

🚨 Never leave your post — wander off mid-shift and the alarm screams. Scramble back before the penalties stack up — peak panic-recovery comedy.

🪑 Play your way — full Standing / Room-Scale, or kick back in Seated mode. Your station, your rules.

🏆 Climb the leaderboards — Steam Arcade Best and Deadline Best boards, a fresh Weekly Leaderboard, and a global Daily Challenge with one shared seed for the entire world.

🏅 ~15 achievements with names like Employee of the Month, Yeet Express and Bull in a China Shop — earned by being very good, or very, very bad at your job.

Party Tycoon: Takeover

Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors, and turn a rough room into the hottest venue in town - then do it all again somewhere bigger.

Before the doors open - Pick tonight's event, take the crates off the delivery dock, haul them to the bars and pour the counters full, put your crew on their posts, and fit the room out. Whatever you forget now, you fix with a queue already outside.

Work the floor yourself - Check the line at the door, take the entry money at the till, pour the drinks, mix the cocktails, take coats over the counter, sweep up after them. Every post can be crewed instead - or benched, and then the job is yours.

Every guest wants something - They come in thirsty, get hungry, need the toilets, want their jacket back at the end. VIPs want the lounge, troublemakers want a fight, and the night's guest star wants a stocked bar and a clean floor before they will say a good word about you.

Stock runs out - Four drinks to a crate, twelve to a bar, two crates in your arms and only so many slots on the rack. Sell fast enough and you spend the night carrying boxes.

Count the night - The doors close, the takings land, and what came in tonight pays for tomorrow: more crew, more counter space, better decor, and eventually a bigger room.

Survive the night - Police raids, blown fuses, surprise headliners. No two nights run the same.

Make your own fun - Out on the yacht, the guests at the pool's edge never see you coming.

Features

  • 8 venues to unlock and build up - from a damp basement to a canal barge, a yacht and a moon dome (more coming)

  • More than 250 event nights, each with its own crowd, modifiers and payout

  • Three goals a night, drawn from over 80 goal types - pour drinks, hold the hype above 75 for 100 seconds, check 22 jackets, eject troublemakers, get through a police raid without a bust, or pet two basement rats before the doors open

  • A supply chain with a limit at every step - the delivery dock fills a crate rack that starts at two slots, you carry two crates at a time, a bar holds twelve drinks, and a counter holds only as many poured glasses as its rack has room for

  • Eight things guests pay for - entry, drinks, long drinks, cocktails, VIP bottles, snacks, the cloakroom and the photo booth - each with its own price, its own stock and its own queue

  • A prep phase, a night in three acts, and a close-out: stock and staff the room before the doors, work it while it is full, then spend the takings before the next one

  • More than 20 stations to run - beer bar, cocktail counter, VIP bottle service, cash desk, cloakroom, food truck, photo booth, show stage

  • Over 20 crew roles, each trained up over five levels, and a lot of upgrades to buy - faster tills, bigger glass racks, more coat rails, extra crate slots, better prices

  • More than 30 decor pieces, three levels each, to raise a venue's ambience and start every night hotter

  • Guests with their own thirst, hunger, patience and mood, plus VIPs, troublemakers and eleven named guest stars who each want the night run their way

  • No two nights alike - difficult VIPs, police raids, blown fuses, surprise headline DJs

Passage 5 is the new entry in a series that has accompanied many of our players for over twenty years. The principle has always been the same – and that's exactly the point: place your tiles so that either color or symbol matches the neighbors. Complete rows and columns – the passages – disappear from the board.

Sounds simple. It is. And that's what makes it so good: a puzzle you understand in thirty seconds and that won't let go of you three hours later. Plan ahead and you'll clear several passages at once – play by feel and you'll have to get creative.

Four Game Modes


  • Clear – Play away the marked tiles. Over 400 levels.
  • Continue – Keep placing endlessly, as long as the board allows.
  • Classic – 72 tiles, each only once. Classic high-score chasing.
  • Construct (new) – The counterpart to Clear: fill the marked fields instead of clearing them.

Three Campaigns


Travel around the world in 80 days, discover the animals of the world, or wander through art history from Botticelli to Munch. Each campaign leads through ten stations with their own backgrounds and tile sets – and every station you complete unlocks its background for free play.

For the First Time Two Players

  • Coop – Two players on one screen, two cursors, one shared score.
  • Duel – Split board, each player gets their own half. Who clears first? Across several levels, best-of, as Last Man Playing or on points – with 150 dedicated duel levels.
  • Against the computer – Playing alone? Take on a computer opponent in four strengths, from Easy to Ultra.
  • Online with friends – Coop and Duel over the internet, too, with Steam Remote Play Together.
  • Devices are assigned FIFA-style: whoever confirms on their device is in. Keyboard, mouse, multiple gamepads – all in parallel.

Special Tiles and Streaks


  • Bomb, row and column bomb, joker and color tiles with silver sides keep the board moving.
  • Streak system: how many passages can you complete in a row without missing a playable tile?
  • Four difficulty levels – new addition: Hardcore, for anyone who finds Hard too easy.
  • Optional move timer on the higher levels – skip it if you don't want the pressure.

Your Game, Your Look

  • 15 tile sets and dozens of backgrounds, freely combinable – or shuffled at random with every level.
  • Your own backgrounds and tile sets: just drop images into the game folder.
  • Steam Workshop – Share your own backgrounds and tile sets with others and subscribe to community creations.
  • Music your way: several built-in channels from pop and relax to classical – or simply pick a folder of your own.
  • Spoken tutorial in 12 languages – no long reading required.

High Scores and Achievements


  • 55 Steam achievements and Steam leaderboards – new to the series.
  • Online leaderboards in addition to local high scores, separate tabs per mode and difficulty.
  • Monthly high score events for each game mode with their own leaderboard – for Halloween, Christmas and more.
  • Multiple save slots with individual player names, switchable any time.
  • Steam Cloud: save games and campaign progress on every PC.
  • Full control via mouse, keyboard, or gamepad.

Matter prejudicial to morale

The men have gone to the war. Far behind a front nobody names, the sorting hall is staffed by women who read other people's mail for the Bureau. You have a stamp, a pen, and a card of regulations listing what a soldier must not be told.

Two strangers write to each other through your desk. They have never met, and everything between them is on the paper you are holding. When you bar a line, it is gone from the romance itself as well as from the page. Pass a tenderness and it reaches the other side. Strike it, and as far as either of them will ever know, it was never written.

At the desk

  • Open each letter, strike what must not pass, and stamp it on its way. Your rulings move two things: the bond between the lovers, and how closely the office is watching you.
  • Before some letters leave your hands, you may copy a single line into a copybook.
  • Later, you learn to leave a few words standing in a struck line, in reply.
  • Every ruling is filed. There is no undo at the desk.

What the regulations do not cover

A letter answers a question you only asked in your head. A line you struck weeks ago comes back, uncrossed, in another hand. One of the two stops writing to the other and starts writing to you. The game never says whether the paper is haunted or whether you are coming apart at your desk.

On paper

About 33,000 words of letters, prose and marginalia, roughly two to four hours, in one sitting or two. It can end six ways, decided by two fates at once: what becomes of the lovers, and what becomes of you. The surface is realistic and the story never explains what is wrong underneath it. Ink, gaslight, sorting halls, a waltz heard through a café wall, in a world that feels old and European and never gives its name. Eleven languages at launch. Single-player, text-based, choice-driven.

Passed by Censor's prose is human–AI co-written and human-edited under the author's direction. Its illustrations and ending vignettes are pre-generated with AI image tools and then curated and edited; the music is generated with AI tools; ambience and effects are recorded sound. Nothing is generated while you play.

Build, Explore, Connect, Remix & Play Together

PatchWorld is a live creative sandbox where you build working things by connecting blocks together directly in 3D.

Make a car. Build a synth. Create a multiplayer game. Wire up a robot. Make lights react to your hands. Turn physics into music. Build an interactive world with your friends.

Patching is programming made physical. Grab a block, connect it to another one, change what it does and immediately see the result, while everything keeps running.

There is no separate build mode and play mode. You create inside the world you are already playing in.

Start for free

You don't have to buy PatchWorld to find out whether patching is for you.

The permanent free demo lets you enter PatchWorld, explore public and community worlds, join multiplayer sessions, jams, events and workshops, and start creating with a curated set of building tools.

Build and publish your first world, experiment with patching and meet the community.

If you want the complete creator toolkit and deeper publishing capabilities, you can unlock the full version.

Patch anything to anything

PatchWorld gives you a shared patching language for sound, visuals, logic, physics, movement, interaction and world behaviour.

Connect a button to a motor. Connect a collision to a sound. Connect your hand movement to a light. Make gravity control an instrument. Trigger an animation from something happening on the web.

Start with a few blocks or keep going until you have built an entire interactive system.

With 230+ modular blocks, PatchWorld can become a toy box, a synthesizer, a visual programming environment, a game engine, a performance space, you name it.

Build games, toys and strange machines

Use physics, logic, movement and interaction to make games, vehicles, robots, rides, puzzles, contraptions and playable worlds.

Everything can be opened, understood, deconstructed and patched differently.

You do not have to start from nothing. Take an existing idea apart, change how it works and turn it into something else.

Build instruments and reactive audiovisual systems

Music is where PatchWorld began, and it is still one of its deepest creative systems.

Build synthesizers, samplers, sequencers, drum machines, effects and completely new instruments using PatchWorld's real-time spatial audio engine.

Then patch sound into everything else: lights, particles, movement, physics, avatars, environments and gameplay.

Inspired by modular synthesis, Pure Data, Max/MSP, TouchDesigner and node-based creative tools, PatchWorld brings patching off the flat screen and into a space you can physically move through.

Build together

PatchWorld is multiplayer by design.

Create a machine while somebody else builds the world around it. Jam with instruments made by another creator. Take something apart together. Host a workshop, performance or live experiment.

PatchWorld already contains 500+ reusable devices and more than 3,000 published community worlds to explore, learn from and remix.

Our community also runs jams, workshops, co-design sessions and live events where new and experienced patchers build together.

Connect PatchWorld to the outside world

Your patch does not have to stop at the edge of PatchWorld.

Connect PatchWorld with bidirectional MIDI, OSC, Ableton Link and WebBridge, alongside external controllers, software and creative workflows.

Patch hardware to virtual objects. Use custom web interfaces to control something inside a world. Connect PatchWorld to a studio or performance setup.

The idea is simple:

Patch anything to anything. Live.

PC VR + Desktop Companion Mode

PC VR is currently the complete PatchWorld creation experience.

Desktop Mode is in beta and lets you join supported multiplayer sessions, move through compatible worlds, observe, film, record and stream directly from your monitor.

We are actively developing a much fuller desktop creation experience during Early Access.

Already playing on Meta Quest?

Your PatchWorld identity and creative ecosystem travel with you.

Log in with your existing PatchWorld account on Steam to access your existing Vibz, purchases, worlds and creations.

Early Access: build it with us

PatchWorld has been developed closely with its community for years.

We regularly work with users through bug reports, feature requests, testing channels, experimental builds, workshops and co-design sessions.

Early Access lets us continue improving onboarding, UI/UX, tutorials, multiplayer, performance, creator workflows and Desktop Mode together with the people actually building things in PatchWorld.

Grab some blocks. Connect something. Break it. Remix it. Invite somebody in. See what happens.

Build. Patch. Play. Together.

Key Features:

  • Spatial Patching & Visual Programming - Use more than 200 modular blocks to build logic, visuals, physics, sound, interaction and world behaviour.

  • Multiplayer Co-Creation - Build together, play together, perform together; community is the heart of PatchWorld.

  • PC VR & Desktop Mode - Use PatchWorld inside or outside of VR. Desktop Mode enables you to stream, record, and join sessions right from your monitor.

  • PatchSound - Custom real-time spatial audio engine for immersive and interactive creation, instrument building, sound design and live performance.

  • Library of Devices - Toys, weapons, tools, vehicles, over 500 and growing. 

  • Live Events - Host or join a continually revolving selection of jams, workshops, build-alongs, and festivals featuring live performances, visuals, cameras, lighting, and interactive zones. 

  • Media Connectivity - WebBridge, bidirectional MIDI, OSC, Ableton Link and more.

  • AI Creativity Layer - Generate content in-world with optional AI tools. 

  • Perpetual Free Demo - Features PatchWorld’s core functionality with access to all public/community worlds and all free content, joining public multiplayer sessions, events, jams and workshops; creating and publishing one world, use of a curated Starter Creator toolkit and more!

Build something broken enough to break every enemy — and the game itself.

You don't control the hero. They run the dungeon on their own: pick targets, swing, cast — and die if you built them wrong. The rest of the screen is the real game: an endless, procedurally generated skill tree that you grow in real time while the fight plays out.

The tree is the game

Kills give experience, experience gives levels, levels give points. Every point you spend reaches the hero instantly: faster swings, thicker armor, a skeleton clawing out of the floor, a fireball that eats the room. There is no pause between strategy and combat — what you take in the next ten seconds decides whether your hero walks out of this room. Need a breath? Space slows time to 0.2× and lays out every stat.

Every point is a hit

Allocating any node fires a surge into everything around your hero and closes some wounds. Skill nodes cast the moment you take them. Spending in the thick of a fight is a weapon — saving points for a keystone is a gamble.

Keystones break the rules

Ordinary nodes hand out percentages. Keystones rewrite how the game works — and every one of them sends a bill.

  • Glass Cannon — double damage, −40% health.

  • Vampirism — every hit heals you, regeneration is gone.

  • Archmage — +120% magic damage, physical damage halved.

  • Lord of the Dead — three more minions, your own damage halved.

  • Life Tap — every skill costs health instead of mana.

Twenty keystones and sixteen ultimates at triple the price. Broken builds are made of bargains like these.

A new tree every run

The tree is generated from scratch every time: the nodes, the branches, whatever waits around the corner. A memorized route doesn't survive into the next attempt — only the skill of reading what you were dealt does. Sometimes necromancy shows up two nodes from the start. Sometimes half a run goes by without a single spell.

Your build is broken

When your build outgrows the dungeon — bosses melting in seconds, every blow a massive overkill — the game says it out loud, names what you built (Glass Reaver, Bloodthirsty Archmage, Deathless Bonelord…) and remembers the floor where you broke it.

Twenty floors, then the Abyss

A boss guards every fifth floor, and The Treewarden waits on the twentieth. From floor eight the dungeon stops playing fair: the horde grows with every floor — up to sixty monsters at once, plus gold-ringed elites tough enough to survive your area damage. Win, and the Abyss opens: floors that never end, where the only question left is how broken your build really is.

World 2: The Frost

Beat The Treewarden to unlock a second world for good: four frozen biomes, a bestiary that splits, explodes and heals its own, new bosses, The Frost Queen — and a frost branch of the tree built around slows, shatters and Deep Freeze.

Short runs, lasting progress

Death ends the run and wipes the tree — but not your progress. New nodes unlock between runs: for kills, for depth, for builds you held together, for floors cleared without a scratch. The 85-node codex shows everything you haven't found yet and exactly how to earn it.

Features

  • An endless, full-screen skill tree — the whole game lives inside it

  • A hero who fights on their own in real time; you build mid-fight (0.2× slow-mo, no pause)

  • A procedural tree, new every run, that reads at a glance: color = school, shape = type, size = tier

  • 20 rule-breaking keystones and 16 ultimates at triple the cost

  • Warrior, ranger, mage, necromancer — and every hybrid in between

  • An 85-node codex unlocked through meta-progression

  • Two worlds of 20 floors, ten bosses and an endless Abyss

  • 10–30 minute runs

  • Fully playable in 15 languages

A semi-idle crafting sim inspired by Path of Exile, for when you still love the loot but not the grind. Forge gear, gamble on affix rolls, and equip the adventurers who quest and delve in your place. Craft their gear, seal their fate.

Discover different item recipes to craft and master. Send adventurers on quests or dungeon diving to get loot and earn experience. Everything they bring to a fight, you made. Lean in and optimize every roll, or set the workshop running and check back later; progress accrues either way.


  • Crafting system inspired by Path of Exile, suitable for experienced and newcomers.

  • Discover and craft over 100+ items to aid adventurers.

  • Master the art of crafting to produce exceptional items.

  • Imbue, not gamble, them with affixes to take them to the next level.

  • Recruit adventurers with traits and skills that amplify stats on different item families.

  • Send adventurers on quests and dungeons to gather loot. Only if you survive them!

  • Craft golems to automate shop on the boring stuff, so you can focus on imbuing, again not gambling.

  • The Forge. Your own slot machine crafting station to roll the best affixes rolls.

I was transported to a parallel world inspired by Journey to the West, only to be reincarnated as a yaoguai for the sins of my past life. A chance encounter grants me the Reincarnation Casket and the power to begin life anew without end. In this treacherous world, rival factions are on the move and long-buried truths are about to surface. In my next life, will I return as a pig, a monkey, a lamp... or even a tree? Buddhahood demands eighty-one trials—but the path of a yaoguai is no less perilous.

I'm only a little yaoguai... and I really do want to live another five hundred years.

Choose from 72 yaoguai, each with distinct attribute affinities. Through the reincarnation legacy system, what you leave behind in one life can pass on to the next, carrying your journey forward even after you fall.

Experiment with more than 50 build archetypes and over 1,000 cards. Every character comes with unique attributes and card combinations. Grow through battle, Chance Encounters, and Cultivation as you improve your level, attributes, and cards. Combat also incorporates distinctive mechanics such as Weapons, Clones, and Transformations.

Explore a procedurally generated open world spanning 20,000 tiles, brought to life through more than 1.5 million Chinese characters of narrative. Each lifetime brings thousands of random events and new opportunities for growth, while your choices lead to more than a hundred possible endings.

Conquer a wealth of boss encounters and seize strongholds to establish your own Camp. Expand it, recuperate, recruit Yaoguai Troops, earn their loyalty, and build a lasting domain of your own.

The many materials gathered along your journey can be traded to merchants for Spirit Stones—or fused into Mystic Treasures powerful enough to turn the tide of fate.

Forge bonds with immortals, yaoguai, and mortals alike. Become sworn siblings, marry, rob, or attack them—the tangled web of virtue and vice turns on every choice you make.

Your train is your fortress

Path to Catakombs is an action-strategy roguelite in which you lead a combat train through procedurally generated underground catacombs.

Man the locomotive's machine gun, direct your crew's fire and decide when to boost or brake. Kobolds surround the train and climb aboard. While your fighters hold them off, you must watch the tracks, protect vulnerable wagons and react to new threats.

Build your combat train

Start with a locomotive and recruit your own crew. Hire fighters from ten specializations, from gunners and snipers to alchemists, mechanics and electricians. Divide the limited space in your wagons between crew and equipment.

At pit stops, add wagons, reinforce their hulls and fit rams and defensive modules. Repair damage and restore wrecked wagons before the next stretch of track.

Your fighters earn experience in combat, while mechanics gain it by making repairs during battle. Each new rank automatically grants a random upgrade for their profession. Raise your own veterans or inspect an experienced recruit's upgrades before hiring them.

Choose a doctrine and create synergies

Before each run, choose one of three doctrines: gunnery, alchemy or engineering. Your doctrine determines which synergies you can create and how different professions work together, while leaving you free to recruit any fighter.

At pit stops, combine crew in pairs and trios, build connections between neighboring wagons and try new combinations:

  • With the gunnery doctrine, a gunner paired with an electrician triggers chain lightning on hit.

  • With the alchemy doctrine, a sniper shatters an alchemist's ice mark, sending a fan of shards into enemies behind the target.

  • With the engineering doctrine, an electrician and a fire alchemist create two drones: one sprays fuel, the other ignites it.

Synergies add combined effects, devices and new ways to fight. Discovered recipes stay in your encyclopedia between runs.

Plan your route and take risks for loot

Plot a route on the map and change direction at junctions. Mine chambers, spider galleries and kobold camps form new networks of tracks. A shorter route may spare your train, while a detour can lead to loot and extra battles.

Find recipes, rescue survivors, send crew on sorties and haul crystals under enemy pressure. Decide whether to stay for another reward or reach the exit with what you have left.

Defeat the masters of the depths

Enemies flank your train, fire from a distance and board your wagons. Bosses demand new ways of using your train: escape the ogre's grip, shoot off the gnoll's attachments and free wagons from the Matriarch's webs.

A destroyed wagon loses its crew and equipment, leaving a charred wreck in the train. If the locomotive is destroyed, your run is over.

Demo: Act I and endless mode

Fight through the nine locations of Act I. After defeating its final boss, you can continue in endless mode with your train, crew, upgrades, gold and synergies intact.

Enemies grow stronger with each new leg, and a boss is chosen at random from Act I's roster. Doctrine restrictions on recipes are lifted: try new combinations and see how much more your train can take.

1. In-Depth Political Strategy

  • In Path to Power, you are tasked with managing not merely a character, but the entire political trajectory of a nation. Implement sweeping reforms, allocate scarce resources, navigate intricate relationships with the elites, respond to brewing crises, and consolidate your position step by step. Every single decision reverberates across the economy, public approval, systemic stability, and the internal balance of power.

2. Kazakhstan: A Path of Reform and Development

  • The game is set in 1992 Kazakhstan—a pivotal turning point when a nascent state is fiercely searching for its own identity and direction. It is up to you to determine its future: through cautious adjustments, rigid centralization, regional balancing acts, or radical transformations. Govern the nation amidst economic collapse, intense political strife, and a complex web of historical circumstances.

3. Four Paths to Power

Select one of four distinct leaders, each offering a fundamentally unique gameplay style. The Reformer prioritizes structural modernization and economic overhaul; the Apparatchik relies on bureaucratic systems and strict institutional control; the Silovik focuses on law, order, and iron-clad security; while the Regional Leader leverages local elites and a pragmatic, boots-on-the-ground approach. Every candidate possesses unique strengths, vulnerabilities, distinct starting conditions, and an individual trajectory to the pinnacle of authority.

4. Every Choice Carries Consequences

There are no superficial choices in this game: every action leaves an indelible mark on the state and your own political fate. Legislation, reforms, compromises, pressure on the opposition, backroom pacts with factions, and your responses to civil unrest will carve out a completely unique campaign path. Whether you can maintain a fragile equilibrium between state power, civil society, and competing special interests rests entirely on your shoulders.

Pathogen is a game where you cultivate pathogens, aim for high scores, and fight to survive.

<Highlights>

  • The thrill of surviving by a hair's breadth when death is just around the corner!

  • The satisfaction of pushing your score to the limit by combining cards and artifacts!

  • The joy of creating your own optimized build and an overwhelmingly powerful deck!

Pathogen is much more fun to play than it looks!

Survive the experiment! 

The Specter kidnaps the doctors who once experimented on it and forces them to take part in a mysterious experiment.

As one of those doctors, you extract Essence from pathogens.

Extract enough Essence before all 7 Life Coins are gone.

Can you survive the Specter?

Unleash powerful synergies!

Different pathogens can trigger each other's effects to create powerful synergies.

Combine pathogens to extract as much Essence as possible!

Create your own build!

Combine hundreds of cards and artifacts to build a variety of decks.

Upgrade your cards and discover the fun of crafting the perfect deck!

If you love deckbuilding roguelikes, play it now!

Even if you've never played a card game before, anyone can have fun!

PawTop Cats are themed cats that live right on your desktop. They stay on top of your windows, look at you suspiciously, wear cool gear, change skins, and lift your mood.

Decorate your desktop with your favorite cat and make your day a little better. Drag it wherever you like, choose its size, frame, and menu background. Morale goes up. Productivity is not guaranteed)).

A package was delivered to your house by mistake. The address on the package is in another country, so you set out to return it in person, well, in dog (you are a dog).

The country turns out to be a strange place. People (dogs) there settle everything with target-shooting duels. Nobody finds this odd except you.

The trick is the ricochet: bullets bounce off walls, so the best shots are the ones that look impossible until they land. Hitting targets shakes your opponent's confidence.

Along the way you travel with a cat who was raised by dogs and firmly believes she is one. You meet the locals, run into trouble, help random grandma, and sort most of it out with a well-placed bank shot.

Features

  • Meet random dogs (well, mostly) along the way

  • can shoot everything

  • Pretty scenes

  • Interesting levels

  • random minigames

and a lot more to explore!

Everything is visible but the Dark.

Reveal the tiles beside your pawns, one step at a time, as you explore an 8×8 dungeon in this tactical puzzler.

The Tension of Exploring the Unknown

The dungeon is shrouded in darkness. Move your pawns forward, one step at a time, and venture into the unknown.

Nothing there? No. You were spared.

One Step Between Life and Death

Taking your last step into the Dark is rarely a wise move. What will you do if an enemy is lurking there?

Minimalist Board-Game Rules, High-Stakes Decisions

No misses. No critical hits. If an enemy with 3 ATK attacks a pawn with 3 HP, that pawn goes down. There's no luck involved in combat.

That's why you must read every piece of visible information, make the most of your limited resources, and find a way through this unforgiving tactical puzzler.

Every Step, Every Move, Every Point Matters

The thief has reached the stairs, but enemies have them surrounded. One step left. So, what's your next move?

Pay Your Space Debt is an incremental mining game with survivor-lite action.

You’re drowning in debt and the collectors are closing in. Grow stronger, manage your debt and fight to survive long enough to finally break free!

Mining

Mine asteroids, harvest ores and use your haul to pay down what you owe.

Upgrades

Purchase upgrades to mine faster, earn more and survive longer.

Debt Collectors

Target special asteroids and use weapon upgrades to fight them off and stay alive.

Debt repayment

Pay off debt for a bonus and stop collectors from getting stronger.

Survive and Pay Your Space Debt!

THE CARTEL DOESN'T FORGIVE DEBTS: PAY OR DIE!

Deep in a scorching, lawless desert border town, you're an ambitious arms dealer trapped in the cartel's crosshairs. Your debt is piling up, the ruthless bosses are demanding their cut, and the clock is relentlessly ticking. Your only salvation? Run an underground weapons depot, fulfill high-stakes orders, rake in cold hard cash, and survive.

KEY FEATURES

  • Level Builder — Place every tile the official levels use. Test instantly. Publish when it's perfectly fair.

  • Community Levels — Every published level is playable by everyone, forever — an ever-growing gauntlet.

  • Best & Worst Runs — Deaths and time tracked per level, so your progress is never forgotten.

PhDing in the UK is a pixel-art life sim about a Chinese student doing a doctorate in Britain: chasing thesis deadlines, meeting your supervisor, missing home, plus a card-battle system. Every argument, every viva, every group meeting is a boss fight you never signed up for.

Tuition paid, bags packed, and somewhere between Heathrow and a rented room in Sheffield you became a PhD student. Nobody warned you that surviving it would come down to card games.

  • Manage your days, not just your thesis: Every waking hour counts. Write, read, cook, exercise, or just stare into space. The clock, and the deadline, will not stop for you

  • There is a lot of day left after the writing: Fish an afternoon away by the park lake, roll a couple of dice at the casino, work a shift to afford a chair that will not wreck your back. None of it advances your thesis, and all of it decides what shape you walk into the next fight in

  • Build a deck out of your own arguments: Learn different schools of skill cards from different supervisors, curate them within a strict capacity, and turn every academic crisis into a turn-based showdown

  • Form real bonds, and maybe more than bonds: Labmates and friends with their own personalities and their own deep-talk arcs. Someone might "happen" to walk past your building with an umbrella on a rainy day. Who you open up to gets written into your ending

  • See the world on a student budget: Travel between terms and to conferences, from Tokyo backstreets to Roman ruins

  • Fully localized, ten languages: Simplified and Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian. Every line has its own version

  • Multiple endings: Who you become by graduation depends on every small choice along the way

Equal parts cozy and chaotic, sincere and self-deprecating. This is what nobody tells you about doing a PhD abroad.

Build Your Deck and Reclaim the Lost Constellations


The stars above the Six Academies are going dark, one by one. The names and memories bound to them are vanishing as well.

Choose your Academy, build a 30-card deck, pursue sealed records, and recover scattered memories as you uncover the truth behind the fading stars.

Build a Strategy of Your Own


Choose minions, spells, and weapons from 168 cards available at launch. Create chains of effects around Academy skills, card abilities, and Bonds.

Manage your Mana, board position, and attack timing. Every turn asks you to choose between pressing the attack, protecting a key unit, or preparing for the next round.

Refine decks built around aggression, control, healing, Armor, spell combinations, sacrifice, or Fatigue, then test them against different enemies and Boss mechanics.

Master the Six Academies


Command the Ember, Tide, Gale, Stone, Radiant, and Umbral Academies.

Every Academy features a distinct hero skill, card synergies, and deck-building identity. Master a favorite strategy or expand your collection to explore new Academies and combinations.

Reshape Cards with Startraces


Fuse duplicate cards into a chosen main card and engrave it with permanent Startraces.

Combine Startraces, Bonds, Card Fates, and Boss Imprints to strengthen a card's attributes and tactical abilities. Even an ordinary card can grow throughout your journey and become the heart of your deck.

Challenge the Stolen Memories


Journey through an eight-chapter campaign spanning 60 nodes and confront eight Bosses with unique mechanics and changing phases.

Travel deeper into the Six Academies through card duels, story events, and route choices. Recover sealed records and piece together the memories scattered across the stars.

Each chapter features its own story sequence and Boss encounter. Study the Boss, adjust your deck, and prepare for each phase transition as you pursue the truth behind the Tide of Oblivion.

Raid Supercharged Bosses Together


Enter Co-op Raid with an AI companion or one friend. Each fighter brings their own 30-card deck to face eight supercharged Bosses.

Both players manage their own Health, hand, Mana, and board, taking turns before the Boss phase begins. Watch whether your teammate summoned, cast a spell, attacked, or used an Academy skill, then answer with the right action to trigger a team combo.

Some cards also gain co-op support abilities, allowing you to heal your teammate, grant Armor, and help the party survive the Boss's assaults.

Defeat seven rotating regular Bosses to unlock the final raid target. Clearing the finale opens a new raid cycle with a new rotation.

Conquer Extreme Bosses


Defeat a Co-op Boss on Normal to unlock its Extreme challenge.

Extreme Bosses have more Health, stronger phase mechanics, a faster tempo, and far more dangerous party-wide assaults. Victory demands more than a powerful individual deck—it requires complementary builds and carefully coordinated actions.

Clear an Extreme raid to earn bonus resources and a Boss Trophy Pack for your next challenge.

Choose Your Challenge


Beyond the complete Star Map campaign, several standalone modes await:

  • Roguelike Adventure: Climb through eight floors of randomized trials. Choose routes across three difficulty levels, gain temporary upgrades, and push deeper into each run.
  • Free Battle: Choose any available Academy and deck, then challenge the AI in a standalone duel.
  • Eight Sovereigns: Unlocks after completing the main campaign. Use the same deck to face all eight Bosses in succession while Health carries between battles. Choose one field supply after every victory, with the Boss order changing between runs.
  • Astral Arena: Unlocks after Chapter 1. Pursue seven wins before suffering three losses, face increasingly powerful opponents, and open a rank chest based on your final record.
  • Co-op Raid: Fight supercharged Bosses alongside an AI companion or a friend, using support effects and team combos to complete repeated raid cycles.

Play Together Through Steam or LAN


The full Steam edition supports Steam friend rooms and invitations.

The full game also supports LAN duels and Boss raids. Create a room on the same local network and the game will automatically discover available sessions.

Whether you connect through Steam or LAN, both players can bring their own 30-card decks and face each other in a private one-on-one duel, or form a two-player party and challenge a Boss on Normal or Extreme. No public matchmaking server is required, making it suitable for homes, dorms, and in-person gatherings.

Play at Your Own Pace


Phantom Cardia: Astral Card Duel is a deck-building card game centered on offline single-player content, with additional AI co-op, LAN multiplayer, and Steam friend multiplayer.

The complete campaign, deck progression, and main challenges can be played offline. Even without going online, you can experience the full Co-op Raid rules with an AI companion.

The game is sold as a one-time purchase. Card packs and resources are earned through play, with no forced advertising, paid card pulls, or daily-task pressure.

Classic detective thriller with twisted plot and unpredictable turns will never go out of style. PHANTOM is a noir visual novel that combines complex puzzles based on real encryption methods with a police investigation simulator.

The Idea

When detectives discover six bodies at the city port, it becomes clear that this is only the beginning for a killer who has hit his stride and decided to officially challenge the police through an encrypted manifesto. You play as Barry Dalton — a cynical police crypto-analyst suffering from chronic insomnia, who flawlessly navigates the dark corners of serial killer psychology.

Shape Your Story 

The decisions you make affect not only the development of professional, friendly, or romantic relationships with characters, but also drastically change the course of the investigation and determine how many lives are saved from the killer. Listen to radio broadcasts to learn the consequences of your actions for the city, skillfully extract information during dialogues, and critically analyze every message from the maniac: is it a real clue or just another psychological manipulation?

Decryption Mechanics 

You will have to dive deep into the basics of cryptography. Besides the Phantom's letters, which are encrypted using Enigma machine, you will regularly assist the department with the codes of drug cartels, corrupt officials, and street gangs. Someone uses the classic Caesar cipher, another prefers the Vigenère square, and for some, Morse code is enough — your task is to visually recognize each algorithm and crack it using unique methods.

◆ Story

──Fight for freedom.

The Celestial Realm, home to the angels, was ruled by a belief that God should make every decision and determine everything.

Unable to accept this, the angel Pheles rebelled against God in pursuit of freedom, becoming a fallen angel.

Some time later, Pheles encounters two knights who harbor a grudge against God.

However, the knights suffer from extreme indecisiveness, leaving them unable to make decisions on their own.

Pheles makes their decisions for them and leads them into battle against God and the angels.

◆ Game System

■ The Basics

Pheles Rebirth is a turn-based RPG where you lead two knights into battle.

Based on the Strategy you set beforehand, the knights randomly suggest what they should do next.

Choose the most suitable Suggestion from those presented and put it into action.

Both your party and the enemy can act three times per turn. Predicting the enemy's actions and deciding what to do next is key to victory.

Attack? Defend? Inflict a status ailment? Set up for a powerful effect?

Your choice of Suggestion can drastically change the course of battle.

■ Turn the Tide with "Unleashed Thoughts"

Unleashed Thoughts are powerful effects that activate when specific conditions are met during battle.

For example:

  • Use a skill with a specific ability a certain number of times

  • Have multiple high-cost actions suggested at once

  • Let a certain number of turns pass

Each Unleashed Thought has its own activation condition.

Pay attention to these conditions and you can unleash powerful effects capable of completely turning the tide of battle.

Deciding which Unleashed Thoughts to trigger—and building your skills and abilities around them—is an important part of your strategy.

■ Expanding and Diversifying Your Strategies

Around 200 different goals are available, and completing them unlocks new skills, abilities, and Unleashed Thoughts.

Combine the unique abilities of both knights with Unleashed Thoughts to find the ideal Strategy for each enemy and battle.

Drag a token on your phone, see it move on your host's big screen

Roll a handful of dice on the Cleric's iPad, see its results on the Warlock's Steam Deck

Build a giant dice tower on your Android, see it tumbling down on the Wizard's laptop because somebody threw an oversized d20 at it from across the map. At least it landed on a :)

All without melting anyone's battery in under 2 hours

Touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT

Yup, you heard me. 

Platform:

Native software: Native compiled code allows for optimizations that web based VTTs can only dream of.

Touchscreen first development: Phroller was built for modern touch controls first. Use two fingers to resize/rotate images and control the camera. Better mouse, keyboard and controller support always in the works!

No account required: Quick Zoom/Jackbox styled session hosting and joining. All shared assets are shared between the users directly.

Offline prep: Phroller lives on your device. Images and Models saved to your collection are put into your own device storage and can be used without an internet connection!

Battery life without compromise: I spent weeks optimizing for battery life to make sure the platform stops overheating even through my longest DnD sessions.

Gameplay:

Collaborative GM-ing: Every user in a shared session could be given permissions to controls usually reserved for the GM. Ask your players to help draw a basic map, put decals on the board or even randomly place/control enemy tokens while you finalize stat blocks. You can do it at a real table, why not on a VTT? You can even share a revocable passcode with your players to give them full GM privileges!

Delightful Physics: More than just delightful dice rolling, you can throw your tokens across the map too!

Multi-level maps: easy to adjust level system lets you visualize and manage complex scenes featuring multiple elevations. With 3 different visualization modes depending on your needs [Side by side comparison of the three views]

Customize! You can customize the style of the vtt grid, the dice trays, the UI, the dice and even fill any of them with as much custom art as you want. Built in access to several massive libraries of art and symbols to personalize every part of the platform!

Smart Drag and Drop:

  • Images

    • in Decal Mode: Become maps and stickers

    • in Token Mode: Become paper mini/sticker tokens

    • in Prop Mode: Become 2.5D styled paper scenery pieces

  • 3D Models

    • in Token Mode: Become 3D Tokens

    • in Prop Mode: Become unmovable props

  • PDFs: directly view them on the PDF board. With multi page pdf flipping

    • Yes, other players in a shared session see the page flip with you

Modular Tracking: Configurable widget layouts allow you to build and organize your own character/game managers the way you want. Current widgets available:

  • Sliders and Counters: Perfect for health and resource tracking

  • List and Tables: Great for attribute, skill, inventory and even turn order tracking!

  • Notes: With support for tabs and images

  • Drawings: You can doodle on the VTT too, but that’s shared with everybody. Why not also be able to doodle on your digital character manager? Also with tab support and image importing.

  • PDFs: Quick access to the various documents you’d want to have on hand.

  • And more!

Featuring asset libraries featuring thousands of art assets. Growing constantly! Want to see your models/art/maps/adventure/etc featured in Phroller? Please reach out to us!

Try Phroller today! The Demo has everything you need to get started.

A haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, every room.

───────────────────────────────── DO YOU DARE ───────────────────────────────── This is Indian horror. This is the horror your grandparents warned you about. The horror that lives in the stories told after dark. The horror that is woven into the soil of this land. If you dare to walk through the dark corridors of an abandoned heritage haveli — if you dare to hold your fear and keep moving — Pichhal Peri is waiting for you. She has been waiting since 1985.

YOUR VOICE IS YOUR ONLY WEAPON

You cannot fight Pichhal Peri. You cannot run forever. When she is close — when you can hear her coming — there is only one thing that can stop her. Speak. Into your real microphone. The mantras you need find inside the haveli. The words that have protected this land for thousands of years. Speak them aloud and she will retreat. Stay silent and she will reach you.

This game contains truly unpredictable jump scares, complete darkness, and a ghost that does not follow rules. If you scare easily — this game is for you anyway. But you have been warned.

ABOUT XOOGAMES

XooGames is an independent studio from Delhi, India dedicated to bringing authentic Indian folklore and culture to gaming. Pichhal Peri is our first game — a horror experience rooted in real North Indian legend, built with love for Indian heritage and storytelling.

Form Your Squad

Purchase units in the unit shop to form your squad. Each unit comes with a unique skill. If multiple units with the same bond are on the field, you can also unlock exclusive bond skills.

Draw Number Resolution

Draw a random number. The grid with the matching number on the board will light up, and the unit placed on that grid will activate its skill. Some skills grant attack value, multiplier bonus, and attack count. The higher these values, the more damage you deal to the boss.

Purchase Treasures

Treasures come with a variety of skill effects to help your squad take on the boss with ease.

Unit Upgrade

Units have a total of 3 tiers. Unit level is extremely important — the higher the tier, the more powerful its own skill becomes. However, unit tier does not affect bond skills in any way.

Play the claw machine! But this time, you're the one calling the shots. Pickie Grappy is a claw-machine arcade sim built around one thing: making every single click feel good. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, watch your little arcade empire grow, and get rich playing the claw machine!

Start with a single humble machine and level up through a growing collection of purchasable, themed claw machines, each stocked with its own cast of unique prizes, from everyday trinkets to genuinely rare finds. Every catch adds to your permanent collection, every rarity tier (Common through Legendary) adds more shine to your ever-growing item log, and of course, the more you catch, the richer you get!

Between sessions, spend your earnings on a deep skill tree: sharpen your click power, boost your odds at rare items, tune the machine to feel easier and friendlier to play, and unlock passive income that keeps running even when you're not playing. Chase achievements, hunt down every last item, and finally earn access to the most coveted special machine in the game.

  • Satisfying claw-machine gameplay: time your clicks, land in the red zone for bonus payouts, and feel the sensation of every catch.

  • 8+ unique machines to unlock, each with its own theme and prize roster.

  • 1 secret machine waiting for players who complete the full collection.

  • Deep skill tree: upgrade click power, timing, luck, and passive income across hundreds of skills.

  • Full item collection system with 5 rarity tiers and a growing item log to fill out.

  • Achievements to chase, with rewards that feed back into your progression.

Pickup Point Simulator

Step into the fast-paced world of parcel logistics and become the manager of your own busy pickup point!

In Pickup Point Simulator, every day brings a new delivery truck filled with packages that must be efficiently processed, scanned, and organized. Your job is to keep everything running smoothly as you handle incoming shipments, track item codes, and arrange parcels in the correct storage locations.

Daily Deliveries

Scan & Receive

Sort Packages by Number

Only by organizing packages properly can you quickly find the ones customers need, improving your store rating.

Verify Customer ID

It's recommended to verify the customer's ID. You can skip it if you want, but you risk handing the package to the wrong person.

Ship a Package

Ship the Package and Check Out

And Much More

And that's just the beginning! Discover even more features as you play—sell unclaimed expired parcels for extra income, relax with games on your tablet during quiet hours, and uncover plenty of other surprises waiting at your pickup point.

Take care of and adopt stray cats.

Buy toys and decorations for your cat island!

Pico Cat

A desktop idle game to keep you company while working and studying.

Place food to attract stray cats! The more food and toys you have, the more cats will come.

The happier they are when leaving, the more cat coins they will leave you!

Put a collar on a kitten to adopt it. Adopted kitties will never leave your island.

After they depart, they will send you letters from time to time. The gifts attached can be used to decorate the island or make perler bead ornaments for your space.

There are over 100 cats with unique looks and personalities — you’ll surely find your favorite one.

Pet, feed and decorate your cat island. Let lovely cats accompany you through work and study every day.

Discover more than 40 kinds of small animals and hundreds of perler bead patterns to brighten up your desktop.

Invite Claude to help manage your cat island. You can also connect to Claude Code and enjoy cyber cat-raising with AI!

Feel free to leave a message if you have any ideas, bug reports or other feedback. I’d highly appreciate your suggestions, and tell me what new features or changes you’d like to see.

A sudden temporal rift shattered the peaceful homeland of the animal folk. The piglet and nine companions were torn apart by a massive void storm, scattered across countless isolated broken planets, and the laws of the universe teetered on the brink of collapse.

Amid the crisis, a miracle quietly emerged. Only the piglet possesses an innate ability to traverse spatial rifts. To rescue its scattered friends and mend the crumbling universe, this ordinary piglet embarks on an extraordinary journey.

Pig Up is a third-person 3D platform adventure game. Take control of the piglet as you climb tier upon tier of floating platforms, travel through distinct alien realms including outer space and magical fantasy landscapes, and overcome countless obstacles to keep ascending. The choices you make along the way will steer you toward different fates, unlocking multiple endings and revealing the full truth behind the temporal chaos.

This game boasts diverse gameplay and a gripping, twisting storyline filled with countless touching narrative moments. It features twelve major levels, each transporting you to a distinct, self-contained world with unique scenery and an original tale. Blending puzzle-solving, exploration and more, follow the little pig on an adventurous journey to rescue its companions. It braves numerous perils and hardships to save its friends, and at the end of the story, a difficult dilemma awaits the player.

In every level, you must locate and rescue trapped companions. Upon saving each companion, the little pig gains a brand-new skill. These abilities are essential for progression and require skilled mastery. As you advance through levels, new environments and skills keep unlocking, building up the sense of adventure and satisfying gameplay moment after moment.

Cosmic shards are scattered across levels. Collect enough of them to open the gate to the next world. More than mere progression items, these shards play a vital role in the main storyline and profoundly shape how the story unfolds.

The game also includes a simple yet fun costume system. During exploration, players can earn a variety of exquisite outfits by completing story quests and opening treasure chests. Swap costumes freely in the inventory to create your one-of-a-kind little pig.

The planets lie shattered, with companions stranded everywhere. Guide the little pig as it leaps between floating platforms, gather crystals to unlock new powers, and navigate intricate mechanisms and puzzles. Seek out these nine lost companions along the way. Meet them, travel alongside them, and gradually uncover the truth behind this broken world. If you enjoy smooth, responsive platforming and love meeting new friends on your adventure, join the little pig and set off on this quest to reunite all companions.

Here is a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos.

Our pigeon wakes up in the middle of the city, and cannot fly yet.

People avoid it as something filthy, and turn it into a punchline.

But our brave pigeon could not care less.

There is only one thing on that little mind: the Galápagos, seen on a TV through a shop window.

But to fly all that way, a pigeon needs something no other pigeon has.

『50 Recipes to Become a Legendary Pigeon』, found on the street, is a notebook full of -
hints about the golden sunflower seed.

Wandering from place to place, our pigeon meets street pigeons pecking at garbage,
and house pigeons living alongside people. When it rains, try an umbrella!

And then our pigeon falls into a trap no pigeon could ever resist.

You wake up in the storage room of a house you have never seen.

Something that guards this house almost caught you.. but playing a stuffed toy seems to have worked.

A robot vacuum — and if it works out that you are a pigeon, you are in trouble.

Help this slightly odd, slightly clueless robot vacuum with the little chores around the house.

Then cook what you gather!

It might become a precious gift for a friend, or a costume to dress your body with. — The slice of bread stuck around your body is one of them.

Did the pigeon ever fly to the Galápagos, the way it dreamed?

And why did a pigeon come to dream such an absurd dream at all?

Would it really have been so bad to just stay here?

Your Machine. Your Chaos.

Drop the coin, pull the launcher — and watch your board turn into a living fireworks show of hand-drawn neon effects. Pin a Million is a pachinko roguelite for players who don't just want the ball to fall through, but want to actively rebuild, combine, and blow up their own board.

Fuse Pegs Into Monsters

Over 30 base pegs — from magnets to fireballs to three-hit miniboss golems — can be [b]permanently fused[/b] together. Fire + Fan becomes a spinning inferno vortex; Blackhole + Bomb becomes a supernova that clears the board. In total, [b]41 unique fusions across 3 tiers[/b] are waiting to be discovered — all the way up to absurd Tier-3 legendaries like GOD MODE or Galaxy Brain. Every fusion has its own hand-drawn look — no sprite sheets, everything rendered live.

Weather, Day, Night, Moon Phases — It All Matters

Rain soaks your pegs and weighs your ball down, thunderstorms send lightning across the field, wind pushes your ball off course. Layered on top is a day/night cycle with eight moon phases: at full moon, gravity pegs go into overdrive; at new moon, peg power drops but your score skyrockets. Some fusions only react at certain times of day — who knows what's waiting at dawn?

Built for the Road: Steam Deck

Your cabinet fits in your pocket. Pin a Million was optimized for Steam Deck from day one: just launch and play, no fiddling with settings. The full neon fireworks show, silky smooth, with tailored controls. Couch, train, lunch break: your next quota is waiting wherever you are.

Your Twitch Chat Plays Too

Streamers, take note: connect your channel, and your chat can jump straight into the action with !gravity, !fireball, !multiball, !freeze, !earthquake and more — each command has its own configurable limits, so it stays chaotic but fair.

Machine After Machine

Every run is a race against the quota: hit the score target before you run out of rounds, earn tickets, and pour them into a persistent skill tree with dozens of meta-upgrades. New peg types, stronger fusions, bonus effects — your next run never starts from zero.

Minigames, a Wheel of Fortune & Last-Chance Dice

The board occasionally transforms into a Pac-Man, Space Invaders, or Breakout minigame, the Wheel of Fortune spins for huge bonuses, and on the edge of the drain, a roll of the dice decides whether your ball lives or dies.


The Casino Fights Back

Every fifth quota, a boss is waiting for you. Each one changes the rules, rebuilds your board, talks back and cheats in his very own way.

  • House Edge – a croupier who has lost his mind. He spins your whole board like a roulette wheel and forces you into bets the house loves to win.

  • Dealer Break – a Scottish dwarf with too many aces up his sleeve. He deals blackjack right onto your pegs, runs a shell game and makes pegs simply vanish.

  • Polaris – an ancient and painfully polite frost druid. He freezes your board, stretches ice walls into constellations and sends icicles crashing down from the sky.

  • Short Shift – a foreman who has no time for your excuses. He turns your pegs into a conveyor belt, demands piecework and sends in quality control.

  • The House – the owner himself, behind a golden mask. The final boss has a body, and the quota is his life: hit him, break his shield and catch his weak spot.

Every boss has his own face, his own voice and his own music. Beat one and you get a card pack, extra tickets and his trophy.

The full game has 10 casino bosses waiting for you – and The House at the very end. Meet the first five right now in the free demo.

Real Arcade Feel

  • Cabinet bezel with ambilight glow on explosions and lightning strikes

  • CRT/VHS shader for an authentic tube-screen look

  • 27 dynamically shifting arcade tracks during gameplay, plus dedicated music for menus and special moments

  • Full gamepad support

  • Android support

  • Complete German and English localization

And keep your eyes open — this cabinet has more than one secret.

No half measures.

Everything Is Marbles

In this game, everything is a marble. Characters are marbles, skills are marbles, talents are marbles too. Your skill marbles live in the skill box — only once loaded into the launch slot are they ready to fire. Combat is both sides launching marbles into each other.

Brilliant Encounters

A full day-night cycle: blinding noon, campfires that only glow after dark. Push inward along branching maps. Rest and refit at campfires when weary; mysterious events fight dirty — springs, altars, mushroom forests, woods, plains, villages and caves, adventure can strike anywhere. Upgrade your skills at the shop; wild treasures await discovery.

Build Your Squad

Pick your character at the start. Others will want to join along the way — warriors bought at the shop join on the spot, fighting shoulder to shoulder with you, assembling your squad marble by marble. More classes are on the way.

Forge Your Build

Defeat enemies for XP, spend it to level characters for more skills and talents. Some talents are game-changers the moment you take them, rewriting how you play; skills and talents interlock into a one-of-a-kind build. Different characters have different specialties — even the same warrior can walk two completely different paths.

The mountain is yours. So are the bills.

Pinebrook Ski Resort is a ski-resort management sim about running the business, not just building it. Shape trails on free-form terrain, string up lifts, then make the calls that decide whether the season ends in profit or in debt: what to charge, what to build next, and what to do when the weather turns.

📈 Read the crowd

Every morning's turnout depends on the day of the week, the weather, the snow, your rating and your ticket price. Charge too much and the lots sit empty; charge too little and the lift lines grow while your margins disappear. Weekends pack the mountain, weekdays test your costs, and your parking lot caps it all.

⛰️ Carve a real mountain

No grid. Draw trails straight onto the terrain and watch the ground reshape beneath them. Difficulty is graded live from the true slope under every section, so a green is a green because the hill says so.

🚡 Build and keep the lift network

Magic carpets, chairlifts, gondolas and staged lifts to the summit, with adjustable towers and speed upgrades. Lifts wear down and break down; keep your mechanics ahead of it or watch the lines back up.

🌨️ The weather won't wait

Wind shuts your lifts, fresh powder draws a crowd, avalanches close runs, and night falls on the trails you chose to light. Make snow, groom fresh corduroy overnight, and keep the resort open whatever the sky does.

⛷️ Skiers with opinions

Every guest has a skill level and a mood. Beginners want gentle greens, experts hunt the double-blacks. Run a ski school, send the patrol when someone bites off more than they can ski, and handle the injuries and lawsuits when they don't make it down. Celebrities visit too, and they're not shy about their verdict.

📊 Know your numbers

Revenue charts, daily accounts and price surveys show where the money comes from and where it leaks. The Resort Advisor flags problems before they cost you.

🛹 Parks and halfpipes

Draw a terrain park like any other run and it fills itself with kickers, rails and boxes, or cut a halfpipe into the hill. Parks are open to every level: beginners stick to the small features, experts go big, and riders pay per ride. Once your resort grows, guests start expecting one.

🏡 Villas and mountain restaurants

Build ski-in, ski-out villas right on the slopes, with stairs, ski racks and their own path down to the trail. Put a restaurant up on the mountain so hungry skiers can stop mid-run instead of heading all the way back to base.

🏆 Challenge or Sandbox

Chase per-map goals for medals on Easy, Normal or Hard, where tougher tiers squeeze your margins rather than your options. Or go bankrupt trying. When you just want to build, Sandbox is waiting.

🗺️ Five very different mountains

A gentle beginner hill, a steep expert peak, a crater, desert dunes and a volcano: every map is its own puzzle of ridgelines, fall lines and climate.

For years, Lisa has been haunted by recurring nightmares of a burning mansion.
One sleepless night, while watching a television documentary about abandoned places and local legends,
she recognizes the very same mansion from her dreams. Determined to uncover the truth behind
these disturbing visions, she sets out to investigate the mysterious property for herself.

Her search leads her to the old mansion at the end of Pineview Drive. Standing abandoned for
decades near the small fishing village of Lakeview Bay, the mansion has become the subject of countless rumors
and local legends. Even today, the people of the region avoid speaking about the place and its troubled past.

Old records tell of a mysterious cycle that once plagued the area. For many years,
a violent storm would sweep across the region for exactly thirty days. During this time,

Many believed that the old mansion was somehow connected to these terrifying events.

Pineview Drive 2 - Rising Storm is the official sequel to the 2014 horror adventure Pineview Drive and,
for the first time, reveals the story behind the old mansion and the events that have haunted this place for decades.

Collect clues, documents and records to piece together the mansion's past.

Pip runs a fish shop on the beach. Keeping it stocked is your job.

Draw circles to catch fish

Click and drag to draw a circle. Anything inside gets reeled up. The fish will try to dodge, and some are much better at it than others.

Catch as many as you can

Rounds are short, so make every circle count. The whole haul goes straight into your stock.

The shop sells for you

Reinvest every coin

POWER IS EARNED. NEVER BOUGHT.

Pirate Royalty is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where strength comes from playing the game. The shop sells cosmetics only. It does not sell equipment, Royal Doubloons, faster leveling, better drops, or better odds at the Forge. Find power through adventure, then make it your own through the class, build, and gear you earn.

For years, four pirate factions fought across the lands and seas for territory, treasure and power. Their rivalries became so bitter that even the warning signs of a greater disaster could not persuade them to stand together. Rena “The Banished” Clifton tried to warn them, but few were willing to listen.

Then the hurricane came.

Compasses lied, sails turned against their crews and ships from rival factions were drawn towards the same point in the ocean. Rena saved as many pirates as her small fleet could carry before the storm forced them onto an unfamiliar island and shattered the remaining ships along the shore.

The survivors named her Pirate Queen, a title she never asked for and does not fully trust. Now their survival depends on whether old enemies can live beneath the same crown. As one of Rena’s trusted people, you will help hold the island together, earn the loyalty of its divided factions and uncover why the hurricane brought them all here.

GROW INTO YOUR CLASS

Choose your class early in the opening journey, before you begin assigning stat points. Become a Nautical Bandit and defend your crew from the front. Track enemies and strike from a distance as an Ocean Scout. Draw magic from the ocean as a Pirate Mage, or keep your allies standing through the strange remedies of an Acolyte.

At level 9, your path is no longer waiting to be chosen. It is waiting to be tested. Each class faces its own trial, built around the qualities its members are expected to carry into the battles ahead. Completing it proves that you have grown beyond your early training and earned recognition among those who already bear your class title.

Your statistics are not assigned for you. Each level gives you points to spend, while skill books and branching skill trees allow you to develop your class further. Pirates who begin with the same training may become very different by the time the island is finished with them.

FIND EQUIPMENT WORTH FIGHTING FOR

Equipment rolls with different values, which means a common weapon and an exceptional one may look alike until you examine what you have found. The finest rolls are rare enough to matter, and every creature, boss and dungeon offers another chance to find something better.

The Forge allows you to open sockets, combine matching gems and place their power into your equipment. Each successful combination creates a stronger gem, but success becomes less likely as its level rises. A forged weapon carries the colour of its gem, allowing other players to see what you risked to make it.

TURN HARD-WON FINDS INTO YOUR NEXT UPGRADE

A sword that does not suit your calling may be exactly what another pirate needs. List eligible gear, gems, and supplies in the public marketplace for Royal Doubloons, then browse for a prize that fits your build. The marketplace gives your hard-won treasure a new purpose. The cash shop cannot buy Doubloons or gear, and valuable items and Doubloons cannot be sent through private trades or gifts.

EARN THE TRUST OF FOUR RIVAL FACTIONS

The Blackwater Buccaneers deal in magical artefacts while questioning the forces Rena claims are at work. The Ledgers guard old knowledge, permits and political ambitions. The Stormclaws are respected hunters who have not forgotten that they once banished Rena. The Fairwinds believe in open trade, though their most valuable technology remains carefully hidden.

Travel through salt worn ruins, forests, stone thresholds and the darker places beneath the island. Marked quests and a guidance orb can lead you towards your next task, but not every secret is waiting beside the safest route.

ENTER WHEN THE PORTAL OPENS

Dungeon portals open on a schedule and warn the whole server before they appear. Gather a party, enter while there is still time, and survive the waves waiting inside. Whether you join a crew or lend a hand outside one, meaningful damage, defense, healing, and protection can earn experience and progress on applicable kill quests. Pirates who contribute take turns receiving a foe’s drops. Your assigned prize is yours—the final blow and the fastest click cannot take it away. Local and World chat, plus private whispers, keep the island connected.
